load_esmfold_v1_model: load the ESMFold v1 pretrained model with 3B ESM-2 and 48 folding blocks from the FAIR model hub
load_esmfold_v0_model: load the ESMFold v0 pretrained model used in the Lin et al 2022 paper from the FAIR model hub
load_esmfold_local_model: load a local ESMFold model from a .pt checkpoint file using the internal _load_model function
load_esmfold_ablation_baseline: load an ESMFold structure module only baseline model such as 8M, 35M, 150M, 650M, 3B, or 15B variants
review_load_model_validation: review the _load_model function to understand how it validates expected keys against found keys when loading model state dicts
